newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-PAS DE RESPONSE SHOWS WELL AHEAD OF CLASSIC.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-PAS DE RESPONSE SHOWS WELL AHEAD OF CLASSIC.

text.p: Pas de Response, Europe's champion filly last year, showed impressive form ahead of next month's English 1,000 Guineas when she comfortably won the Prix Imprudence at Maisons-Laffitte on Friday.
The Criquette Head-trained mount made all the going under jockey Freddie Head and was never in any danger as she won by two and a half lengths in the three-horse race.

"She pleased us and the race should set her up perfectly for the 1,000 Guineas," the trainer said. "Freddie pushed her out towards the end but that was simply to give her a thorough a preparation as possible for the English classic."
Criquette Head has won the 1,000 Guineas three times before with Ma Biche, Ravinella and Hatoof.
